header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Muhammad Sharif Solangi, A.A.G a/w Jeewan Mansha Focal
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation received. Same
body: was the position on last two consecutive dates of hearing. However today, learned A.A.G filed statement of respondent No.5 and submits that respondent Nos.6, 7 & 10 have already filed their statement. Learned A.A.G also submits that subject school is running smoothly. Since no one is in attendance on behalf of the petitioner and no intimation received, it appears that the petitioner has lost his interest to proceed with the petition. Therefore, this petition is dismissed for nonprosecution.
